_comment: PDFium for the native InspCal engine. Statically linked on macOS (see the md-inspcal crate). Prepared by scripts/prepare-inspcal-pdfium.py; never fetched during Cargo compilation.

library.linkage: static archive; exported symbols are private_extern, so a dylib cannot be derived from it

notices_pending: Transitive third-party notices (FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, zlib, Little-CMS, OpenJPEG, Abseil and others in the 8046 build) must be added before distribution (milestone M5).
